record.frame: MJCF world at the zero pose: +x forward (beak), +y left, +z up, trunk_base origin (0,0,120) — the same frame as wiring/cables.json

counts.geometry_clean_means: pierces nothing AND clears the stated 1.0000 mm floor; the overall verdict of such a run is still CANNOT DETERMINE because no published bend limit exists to judge it by

grid.source: every triangle of the 70 rows of ce-assemblies/microduck/current/placements.json, x1000 from metres, sampled at 0.5000 mm
grid.accuracy: distances resolve to the nearest marked CELL CENTRE, so a clearance carries +/- 0.8660 mm (half the cell diagonal) of grid error before the exact refinement in sim/route3d_exact.py

rules.clearance_basis: CHOSEN BY THIS LANE — no source in this repo states a cable-to-body clearance for the Microduck
rules.bend_target: 3 x the bundle OD, reduced at any corner the geometry or the clearance will not allow; ROBOTIS publishes no bend radius for the X3P so the real limit is CANNOT DETERMINE and only the ACHIEVED radius is reported
rules.pose: ZERO POSE ONLY. The routed length is the length at one pose; wiring/cables.json's cable_mm is a floor plus a slack allowance over each crossed joint's whole range. Both are reported and neither overwrites the other.

wire.awg_source: ROBOTIS e-Manual XL330-M288-T 4.4 'Wire Gauge for DYNAMIXEL | 21 AWG'
wire.insulation_window_source: JST eEH.pdf p.2, contact SEH-001T-P0.6, 'Insulation O.D. 1.0 to 1.9' (part:jst-seh-001t-p0.6 spec)
